from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs/task-93d2f6c5.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    a = next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    b = next((r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    dr = 1 if b[0] > a[0] else -1
    dc = 1 if b[1] > a[1] else -1
    r,c=a
    while abs(b[0]-r)>1 and abs(b[1]-c)>1:
        r += dr; c += dc
        if (r,c) != b: out[r][c]=3
    while abs(b[0]-r)>1:
        r += dr
        if (r,c) != b: out[r][c]=3
    while abs(b[1]-c)>1:
        c += dc
        if (r,c) != b: out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)

res=transform(g)
